items.rationale: Only one travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice is covered (7.1.7(f)); the call-out is the first charge on this invoice, so it is indemnified and the separate van line is not.
Investigation to locate the source is covered under 7.1.7(e).

items.description: Moisture measurement of floor and wall base
items.rationale: Measurement of the affected floor and wall base is covered under 7.1.7(e).
Skilled labour at customary rates is covered under 7.1.7(g). 14 hours is high but includes detection work.
This is a second travel charge on the same invoice, after the call-out, so under 7.1.7(f) only the first is indemnified.
Exposing the pipe is necessary repair preparation under 7.1.7(a).

items.description: Removal and disposal of damaged insulation
items.rationale: Dismantling and disposal of affected components is covered under 7.1.7(a) and 5.2.1; the line is small.

items.description: Leak repair and copper section with standard insulation
items.rationale: Repair of the confirmed leak with standard materials is the core covered work.
The roof space was not affected by the damage, so drying there is not covered under 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(b).
Equipment hire for drying is covered under 7.1.7(e) for the affected kitchen. The price is a rough guess.

items.description: Room drying of kitchen floor and wall base
items.rationale: Drying of the affected floor and wall base is covered under 7.1.7(b).
Standard insulation and fittings for the repaired section are covered materials, but this duplicates insulation already invoiced in position 8, so the amount is small.
This is general cleaning, not a repair cost under 7.1.8(a); the reference cases show cleaning lines as low or zero.
This is the drying contractor's only travel charge, so it is covered once under 7.1.7(f).
Removal of a replaced furnishing item is covered under 7.1.7(h).

items.description: Transport and disposal of damaged table
items.rationale: Transport away of the damaged item is covered under 7.1.7(h), but this overlaps with the removal line.
The new-for-old option was taken, so the new price applies with no age deduction: 440 net plus 19% VAT is about 524. The comparable specification means no betterment.
Delivery and setting up of the replacement furnishing item is covered under 7.1.7(h).

items.description: Assembly and cleaning of installation area
items.rationale: Setting up the replacement and cleaning the position where the old item stood are covered under 7.1.7(h).
This is the first and only travel charge of the carpentry contractor on its invoice, so it is covered once.
This is a second travel charge on the same invoice, and only the first is indemnified under 7.1.7(f).

items.description: Inspection of garden furniture for moisture
items.rationale: The furniture was not among the affected parts, so inspecting it is excluded under 7.1.8(f).
